name: A hymn of the temple
about: Composed for this atlas in the manner of a slow hymn sung in Egypt's sanctuaries, from the temples of the pharaohs to the Coptic church and the Sufi zikr: a line that turns about a few notes in maqam hijaz (D, E flat, F sharp, G, A, B flat, C), its augmented second the sound of Egypt to many ears.
